title: Turn the tactical Adjutant into a compact battlefield-first floating Web surface

verification.name: focused tactical Adjutant component gate
verification.command: corepack pnpm@9.12.0 --dir apps/starcraft-tmg-expo exec vitest run lib/level3/__tests__/character-presentation-mount-v2.test.tsx

taskBrief: Implement the Kimi-owned Web presentation sub-slice of Ticket 23 / Slice 248 without changing Client Domain, Rules, Authority, Provider, memory, or character data. Preserve every existing Adjutant operation, BYOK disclosure, portrait recovery path, role-agent message, decision, pending-confirmation and harness-trace projection. Make the floating variant battlefield-first: its collapsed presence must be compact and recognizable rather than a 440px-wide empty bar; its expanded surface must stay inside the viewport and avoid becoming one very long page; organize the existing portrait/comms, session controls, secure Provider setup and diagnostics into accessible progressive-disclosure surfaces so common chat and decision review remain one-step reachable while setup/trace details do not cover the battle table. Keep the inline variant behavior compatible, keep touch and keyboard accessibility, keep reduced-motion behavior, and use the existing StarCraft visual tokens/assets. Do not invent gameplay state, infer hidden information, add a Provider call, or alter the human-confirmation policy. Inspect the diff, write the closure note, and make one scoped local commit. Do not run the acceptance command and do not push.
